choices.text: How are you liking it here?
Have you gone exploring at all?
Can you remind me about something?

lines: Oh! There's so many new things to look at!
Back home, there were these fish that would swim by with the prettiest colors.
I didn't think there'd be anything like that up here, but I keep seeing these things flying overhead.
I can't really make out what they are, but it's fascinating!

choices.text: Hehe, no! It's cute when you get excited.
I'm glad you're enjoying your time here!

lines: I'm glad you convinced me to stay.
I just keep getting this weird feeling in my legs?
I'm not used to moving around on my own like this.
And who knows what could happen if I did?

choices.text: It's okay! You're just a little scared. You can take your time.
Well, maybe one day we can go exploring together!
You mentioned something across the lake?
What was that thing you saw in the distance?

lines: Oh, I was wondering what the other shore looks like.
It's a bit far to go see for myself.
Not yet. Whatever it was, I still can't make it out from here.
